description: The iHomeLab RAPT team publishes electricity measurements from five homes in the greater Lucerne region of Switzerland. Each household has between 1.5 and 3.5 years of observations. The collection separates aggregate demand from major appliances and includes photovoltaic generation for every home, battery power flows for two, and thermal metadata for the three homes with heat pumps. Zenodo provides raw sensor files, a preprocessed five-minute series and processing code in downloadable archives. Reuse is free under CC BY 4.0. The sample is limited to five households and provides detailed examples, not a representative national demand sample, and the raw sampling intervals differ from the regularised series. These measurements support local solar-consumption and storage simulations and appliance-demand calibration. They can supply demand and generation traces for optimisation tools such as model-pypsa.
name: Residential Power Traces for Five Houses: the iHomeLab RAPT Dataset
